chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Abdullah ibn Ayn, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, glorifies Himself three times every day and night. So whoever glorifies Allah with what He glorified Himself with, then if he was in a state of misery, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will turn him to happiness.
He should say: You are Allah, there is no god except You, Lord of the worlds.
You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Mighty, the Exalted, the Great.
You are Allah, there is no god except You, Master of the Day of Judgment.
You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Forgiving, the Merciful.
You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Mighty, the Wise.
You are Allah, there is no god except You, from You the creation began and to You it returns.
You are Allah, Who, there is no god except You, You have not ceased and will not cease.
You are Allah, Who, there is no god except You, the Creator of good and evil.
You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Creator of Paradise and the Fire.
You are Allah, there is no god except You, One, Eternal, He neither begets nor is begotten, nor is there any equivalent to Him.
You are Allah, there is no god except You, the King, the Holy, the Peace, the Believer, the Guardian, the Mighty, the Compeller, the Exalted.

Glory be to Allah from what they associate. He is Allah, the Creator, the Originator, the Designer. For Him are the Good Names. There glorifies to Him whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Great, and the Greatness is Your Robe.

key_terms.الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ: The Creator, the Originator, the Designer

ai.seo_question: What is the specific supplication to recite to turn misery into happiness according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) prescribes a specific litany of divine attributes for daily glorification, linking spiritual remembrance to the transformation of worldly misfortune into happiness. The text explicitly connects these supplications to the Quranic concept of Allah glorifying Himself, citing verses such as Surah Al-Hashr and Surah Al-Ikhlas to establish the theological basis for these names. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on *tawhid* (monotheism) and the efficacy of aligning one's worship with the divine self-description found in the Quran.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abdullah Bin Bukeyr, from Abdullah Bin Ayn, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Glorifies Himself<sup>saww</sup> three times during every day and night. So the one who Glorifies Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with what He<sup>azwj</sup> Glorified Himself<sup>azwj</sup> with, then he was in a state of complaint, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Transform him to a fortunate state.
He should be Saying: ‘You<sup>azwj</sup> are Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, there is no god except for You<sup>azwj</sup>, Lord<sup>azwj</sup> of the worlds!
You<sup>azwj</sup> are Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Beneficent, the Merciful!
You<sup>azwj</sup> are Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, there is no God excep for You<sup>azwj</sup>, the Mighty, the Great.
You<sup>azwj</sup> are Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, there is no God except for You<sup>azwj</sup>, the Master of the Day of the Religion (Judgment).
You<sup>azwj</sup> are Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! There is no God except You<sup>azwj</sup>, the Forgiving, the Merciful.
You<sup>azwj</sup> are Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, there is no god except for You<sup>azwj</sup>, the Mighty, the Wise!
You<sup>azwj</sup> are Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, there is no god except for You<sup>azwj</sup>, The Creation began with You<sup>azwj</sup> and to You<sup>azwj</sup> it will return.
You<sup>azwj</sup> are Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who, there is no God except You<sup>azwj</sup>, neither do You<sup>azwj</sup> decline nor will You<sup>azwj</sup> Cease to be.
You<sup>azwj</sup> are Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Who there is no God except You<sup>azwj</sup>, the Creator of the good and the evil.
You<sup>azwj</sup> are Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, there is no god except for You<sup>azwj</sup>, Creator of the Paradise and the Fire.

You<sup>azwj</sup> are Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, there is no god except for You<sup>azwj</sup>, One, Last, neither do You<sup>azwj</sup> beget nor are You<sup>azwj</sup> begotten, nor will anyone be a match for You<sup>azwj</sup>.

You<sup>azwj</sup> are Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, there is no god except for You<sup>azwj</sup>, the King, the Holy, the the Source of safety, the Securer, the Controller, the Mighty, the Compeller, the Supreme.

Glory be to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> from what they are associating. He<sup>azwj</sup> is Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, the Creator, the Originator, the Designer. For Him<sup>azwj</sup> are the Good Names. There Glorifies to Him<sup>azwj</sup> whatever is in the skies and the earth, and He<sup>azwj</sup> is the Mighty, the Wise’ – up to the end of the Chapter (59).

You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> are Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>. There is no god except You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, the Great, and the Greatness is Your<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Robe’’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from ‘Abd Allah ibn Bukayr from ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘A’Yun from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Allah, the Most Blessed, the Most High, glorifies Himself three times every-day and night. Whoever glorifies Allah with the words with which He has glorified Himself, and happens to be in a condition of misfortune, Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, will turn him into a condition of good fortune.
“He should say, ‘You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Cherisher of the worlds.
You are Allah; no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Most Majestic, the Most (High) Great,
You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Owner of the Day of Judgment.
You are Allah. No one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Forgiving, the Merciful.
You are Allah; no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Majestic, the Wise.
You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, from You began the creatures and to You they return.
You are Allah, (besides whom) no one deserves to be worshipped. You have always been and will always be.
You are Allah, (besides whom) no one deserves to be worshipped, the Creator of the good and evil.
You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Creator of paradise and fire.
You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the One, Self-sufficient, who has not given birth to any one and is not born from anyone and no one is His partner.
‘. . . You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the King, the Holy, the Peace, the Protector, the Dominant, the Majestic, the Compeller, the Proud.

Allah is by far more Glorious than what they call His partners. He is Allah, the Creator, the Designer, the Shape-giver; His are the most beautiful names. All that is in heavens and in the earth glorify Him and He is the Majestic, the Wise ... - to be read to the end of Chapter 59.
You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Most Great for whom greatness is the dress.’”
